post.title: Anthropic S-1: $16.3B Sales, $80.7B Loss, Mostly Non-Cash
post.ig:
$16 billion in sales, over $80 billion lost, mostly on paper.
Anthropic, the maker of Claude, publicly filed for its IPO on Oct 26, 2026.
First-half 2026 revenue: $16.3B, up from $1.16B a year earlier.
Net loss: $80.7B, of which $72.4B was a non-cash charge the filing ties mainly to its rising valuation.
Planned Nasdaq ticker: ANT. Share price and count not set yet.
Sources: Anthropic S-1 (SEC), CNBC, Yahoo Finance.
